what: The always-drawn underline retracts to the right on hover while, at the same moment, a line through the middle of the text draws from the left (.4s power2.out). On release the underline redraws from the left and the middle line exits to the right. A typewriter button meaning ”erase / pick.” With look: shaky, both lines become wobbly, hand-drawn strokes.

options.look: with shaky, a wobbly hand-drawn line (original)
options.under: When off, only the center line with no underline (the original’s sound·social line buttons)

note: On touch devices only the underline remains (the original too, only when pointerType is mouse). If the line children (under·strike) are missing they are created and attached, and removed on leave
